claims: Flynn Clayman is the head men's basketball coach at High Point University.
Flynn Clayman was hired in April 2025 following a stint as associate head coach.
Flynn Clayman led the Panthers to a 31-4 record in his first full season.
High Point University's men's basketball program had its first NCAA tournament appearance in Flynn Clayman's first full season.
The Panthers won back-to-back Big South regular-season titles.
